added_failures_note: the reviewed manifest arms neither baseline_suite nor after_suite (both empty), so there is no base or head gate log to difference and the added-failure count is zero by derivation, not by absence of measurement; the reviewed run's own gate is a single driver invocation, not a test suite

0.reason: robustness of a one-off sheet-rebuild driver whose output the review verified row by row; it is not run again

findings.text: follow-on: `assert delivered == baseline or delivered == rows` admits the pre-rebuild 82-row sheet as a valid committed state, so a regression that reverted the label sheet to the baseline the node was dispatched to replace would still pass the driver unaltered; the disjunct lets the driver accept the very state the rebuild exists to move away from.

follow-on: the driver reaches the private `self.client._driver.session(default_access_mode=READ_ACCESS)` rather than the public `GraphClient.session()` context manager at imas_codex/graph/client.py:274, which owns session acquisition and re-establishes a dead tunnel before raising, and bypasses the read owner `GraphClient.query` at imas_codex/graph/client.py:1004; the read-only guarantee the driver needs has no public accessor, so the divergence is justified today but the copy is left behind whenever that owner gains an access-mode parameter.

item_verdicts.call_sites: no production call site found; the four changed paths are evidence artifacts under docs/evidence/fragments/ and a run script, and a repository-wide search over imas_codex/ and tests/ found no importer, and the html fragment is consumed by the reckon docs server by URL, not by repo code.
item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit cd6073e81 against 9bba70e2d; it adds the driver, the arm key and the html fragment and rewrites the label sheet; the committed sheet and key sha256 match the receipt's output_sha256 exactly (15072cdd... and 4cb8b510...), the sheet carries only the seven allowed fields with no arm key, and the row arithmetic is internally consistent (2x48 contributing outputs less 2 collapsed identical pairs = 94).
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's done_when names a rebuilt sheet, an arm key at srtj-refine-ab-arm-key.json, a driver whose log ends EXIT=0, and an html fragment carrying the counts and the remaining sourceless cases; rebuild.log's last line is EXIT=0 and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-refine-ab-sheet-rebuild.html lists all 67 remaining sourceless cases with a per-case reason and complete/incomplete flag.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to rebuild the refine A/B's blind sheet now that the lost DD sources are restored; docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-refine-ab-label-sheet.json now carries 94 blind rows from 48 of the same 104 complete pairs (was 82 from 42), and the arm key is a separate file at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-refine-ab-arm-key.json.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the summary (82->94 rows, 42->48 contributing cases, 62->56 sourceless complete cases), the driver command under its /test/ line, the EXIT=0 rebuild.log, and two scaffolding retries with their attributions.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the brief grants four fragment paths (label sheet, arm key, html fragment, driver); git diff --name-status 9bba70e2d cd6073e81 changes exactly those four files (one modified, three added) and no production file.

justifications.durability: srtj-refine-ab-sheet-rebuild-run.py:157-186 plants a false arm credit, arm leakage, a blank source path and a blank name and asserts each detector refuses it, and srtj-refine-ab-sheet-rebuild-run.py:257 then admits the pre-rebuild baseline as a passing state, so a reverted sheet would not redden the run.
justifications.evidence: the driver log /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261020T085532215744-srtj-refine-ab-sheet-rebuild/rebuild.log ends EXIT=0 and prints 'REPRODUCTION: recorded context builds 82 rows, 42 contributing cases, 104 complete pairs, 62 complete cases without DD source.', so the gate measures the brief's counts against an independent recorded source.
justifications.fit: srtj-refine-ab-sheet-rebuild-run.py:12-24 imports the recorded builder unchanged and mirrors its adapter shape, and names nothing after a plan label, but srtj-refine-ab-sheet-rebuild-run.py:73 reaches the client's private _driver instead of the public session() at imas_codex/graph/client.py:274.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-refine-ab-label-sheet.json holds 94 rows over 48 contributing cases with the six regained bindings live-resolved, and the arm key is written to a separate file, so the delivered state is the rebuilt blind sheet the goal names.
justifications.reuse: srtj-refine-ab-sheet-rebuild-run.py:169-180 calls the builder's own sheet_key_findings, sheet_leaks, sheet_blank_paths and sheet_blank_names rather than re-deriving them, but srtj-refine-ab-sheet-rebuild-run.py:53-74 re-implements query execution that imas_codex/graph/client.py:1004 GraphClient.query already owns and does not extend it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status 9bba70e2d697060adf3d56f98f06ae0c6bfeca27 cd6073e819ae5c9e0a92076a2cee0dd23b3e141b names only the four fragment paths the brief grants, with no production module and no path outside the declared write scope.
